V. 44.
And he ſaid—On the Day of his Aſcenſion. In the law, and the prophets, and the pſalms—The Prophecies as well as Types, relating to the Meſſiah, are contained either in the Books of Moſes (uſually called the Law) in the pſalms, or in the Writings of the Prophets: Little being ſaid directly concerning Him in the hiſtorical
•ooks.
